verdicts.title: Noncommutative Hodge conjecture
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The paper provides a version of the rational Hodge conjecture for $\3\dg$ categories. The noncommutative Hodge conjecture is equivalent to the version proposed in \cite{perry2020integral} for admissible subcategories. We obtain examples of evidence of the Hodge conjecture by techniques of noncommutative geometry. Finally, we show that the noncommutative Hodge conjecture for smooth proper connective $\3\dg$ algebras is true.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract addresses a noncommutative version of the rational Hodge conjecture for dg categories, with no mention of Tseitin formulas, SAT clause sets, entropy, or d-regular graphs. It shares only the term 'Hodge' with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Cohomology theories for homotopy algebras and noncommutative geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper builds a general framework in which to study cohomology theories of strongly homotopy algebras, namely $A_\infty, C_\infty$ and $L_\infty$-algebras. This framework is based on noncommutative geometry as expounded by Connes and Kontsevich. The developed machinery is then used to establish a general form of Hodge decomposition of Hochschild and cyclic cohomology of $C_\infty$-algebras. This generalizes and puts in a conceptual framework previous work by Loday and Gerstenhaber-Schack.
